title: Distinguish transient vs permanent share-link load failures
body:
## Summary

Share recipient pages used one error card for every failed view fetch: "This link isn't available." That copy is correct when the backend has answered that the token is missing, unknown, revoked, expired, or malformed. It is wrong when the backend never answered — the mid-deploy restart window that produces connection refused, timeouts, or 502/503/504 — because it tells the recipient the link is bad when it is fine and will work in a minute.

This PR classifies the failed request from status / error class and renders different copy:

- **Permanent** (404, 410, other 4xx except 408/429): "This link isn't available." / "Check the link with whoever shared it." No retry action.
- **Transient** (5xx, 408, 429, network errors, anything without a status): "Couldn't load this right now." / "Try again in a moment." plus a **Try again** button that `refetch()`es the view query. No background polling.

Ambiguous failures (no response, unknown error) are treated as transient. A missing token in the URL is permanent.

The results share page (`/r/:token`) is wired to the new card. The owner-side share dialogs are untouched.

### Shared presentation

Classification and copy live in `shareLoadFailure.ts`. The card is `ShareLoadFailureState` (same `LinkOff` icon, `StateCard` layout, and placement as before; only copy and the transient action changed).

The **plan share page is not on `main` yet** — it is landing in https://github.com/brianduff/flunge/pull/1542 with its own copy of the old generic `UnavailableState`. This PR does not duplicate that page. `#1542` (or a follow-up after it merges) should import `ShareLoadFailureState` instead of keeping a second card. The upcoming chore that consolidates shared presentation between the two recipient pages should treat this component as the error surface, not invent another copy.

### Copy (results share page, live)

Permanent (404 from a fake local API):

> This link isn't available.
> Check the link with whoever shared it.
> (no Try again)

Transient (503 from a fake local API):

> Couldn't load this right now.
> Try again in a moment.
> [Try again]

## Validation

- `bazel test --build_tests_only //frontend/...` (`//frontend:jest_test` PASSED)
- `cd frontend && npm run build` (tsc + vite build)
- `./tools/checks run` — no findings
- Jest: classifier table (400/403/404/410 permanent; 408/429/5xx and network/unknown transient); `ShareLoadFailureState` copy + Try again; `ShareResultsPage` 404/410/503/Failed to fetch, Try again re-issues `getShareResultsView` twice and then renders the view, event-level 404 still permanent with no retry
- Live on Vite against a local fake API: `/r/:token` with 404 shows permanent copy and no button; 503 shows transient copy and Try again. Plan share page could not be exercised on this branch because `SharePlanPage` is not present.

## Open Questions

None.
